basics.name: Coby Benveniste
basics.label: Staff / Principal Software Engineer - Backend, Platform & Infrastructure
basics.summary: Backend and platform engineer with 12+ years designing and operating high-scale production systems across Go, Elixir, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and data-intensive architectures. Currently a hands-on VP of Engineering at Marketeam.ai, where I architected and built an agentic AI platform from the ground up; previously Founding Engineer at theGist, Principal Backend Engineer at Arpeely, and Staff Engineer at OpenWeb. Track record includes over 1M RPS low-latency services, event-sourced architecture, cloud infrastructure, reliability, and technical leadership from design through production.

highlights: Architected and built Marketeam.ai's agentic AI platform from the ground up in Elixir/Phoenix, owning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment, reliability, and core technical direction.

Designed a fault-tolerant agent harness, runtime and conversation orchestration layer supporting LLM tool execution, provider-agnostic model integration, asynchronous workflows, and real-time client interactions.
Built production workflow and data infrastructure spanning background jobs, event-driven pipelines, semantic search, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, and end-to-end observability with OpenTelemetry.

Designed multi-tenant security around OAuth2 and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, spearheaded the company's SOC 2 Type II audit, and remained hands-on while leading a cross-functional engineering and product team.

Prototyped the initial Slack summarization bot in 35 minutes and productionized it into a product installed across thousands of workspaces with roughly 5,000 active users, earning a Slack "Brilliant Bots" Staff Pick and Product Hunt Product of the Day.

Architected event-driven ingestion and data pipelines across Go services, SQS/Kafka, EventBridge, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, and Athena, keeping infrastructure costs extremely low while processing Slack workspace data.

As the first hire and founding engineer, acted as chief architect through the product's evolution from Slack bot to Electron/Next.js/NestJS workspace, owned AWS/EKS/Terraform/CI/CD infrastructure, and served as the engineering interface to the Head of AI.
Architected and operated latency-sensitive Go services for real-time ad bidding on Google's ad exchange, sustaining over 1M requests per second while targeting sub-10ms latency.

Replaced expensive managed cloud load balancers with an HAProxy fleet on GCP VMs, using floating-IP/DNS failover and autoscaling to handle multi-gigabyte-per-second traffic and save hundreds of thousands of dollars per month.

Built the company's cross-cluster SRE and observability platform across GKE using Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, and centralized alerting, including operational and business telemetry for bidding spend and win rates.

work.position: Backend Engineer / Tech Lead / Staff Engineer
highlights: Progressed from Backend Engineer to Tech Lead to Staff Engineer, leading a small cross-functional squad before moving into a Staff IC role spanning backend architecture, infrastructure, code review, and hands-on development across Ruby, Elixir, and Go.

Co-designed and migrated major parts of OpenWeb's 2.0 architecture to event-driven Go microservices, using contract-first BFF APIs to isolate clients from underlying service changes across the conversation admin panel, moderation platform, and core conversation system.

Led the design and delivery of Moderation 2.0 for a network that reached roughly 50M registered users, combining real-time APIs handling several thousand requests per second with SQS/Kafka processing for tens to hundreds of thousands of messages per day, depending on traffic.

Built moderation workflows using MySQL, Redis, Google Jigsaw's API, and custom rules for abuse prevention, and led Backend Labs work on fault-tolerance improvements in core message ingestion and Kubernetes performance and cost optimization.

work.position: Software Developer, Data Scientist, Tableau Specialist
highlights: Built and maintained an unstructured-text classification system based on analyst-defined rules that became used across company projects, and developed data models for extracting insights from large datasets.
Became the company's point person for Tableau development, performance, and optimization.
Developed a system to automate federal tax reporting for a real-estate investment company.
Developed proprietary internal tools used across multiple departments to automate and streamline day-to-day work.

Experienced across OTP architecture, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, performance, reliability, and technical leadership; Elixir community speaker at CodeBEAM Europe and ElixirConf EU and creator of LiveLoad.

highlights: Architected and built Marketeam.ai's agentic AI platform from the ground up in Elixir/Phoenix, owning backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment, reliability, and core technical direction.

Designed the production agent harness and runtime around Erlang/OTP gen_statem, using delegated state machines and process monitoring for fault-tolerant tool execution, with conversation orchestration and LiveView/PubSub integration.
Built production workflow and data infrastructure with Oban, Broadway/SQS, Ash's Reactor, PostgreSQL/pgvector, and ETS, alongside AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, and observability with OpenTelemetry.

Designed multi-tenant security around OAuth2 and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, spearheaded the company's SOC 2 Type II audit, and remained hands-on while leading a cross-functional engineering and product team.
